title: Public Health
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 18 units of courses, with at least 6 units at 3000 or above level, as follows:

courses.title: Foundations in Public Health
courses.prereq: PHPC1001 is double-coded with UGEC1920. Not for students who have taken MEDF1021, 1120, UGEC1920 or UGEC2930.

courses.title: Principles of Infectious Diseases
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken PHPC1004.

courses.title: Epidemiology
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken PHPC1014.

rows.text: 12 units of courses chosen from the following, with at least 6 units of courses at 3000 or above level: PHPC1022, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2015, 2016, 2020, 3012, 3014, 3016, 3017, 3024, 3028, 4029, 4033

courses.title: Lifestyle and Health
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken PHPC2008.

courses.title: Environment and Work
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken CHPR2001

courses.title: Global Health
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite:PHPC1001 or MEDF1021 or UGEC1920 or UGEC2930

courses.title: Biostatistics
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken -COMM3110, DSME2010,2020,2011,2021, ECON2121, GRMD2102, PHPC1015, PSYC2010, SEEM2430, SOCI2004, SPED2600, STAT2101,2102,2001 or 2006.

courses.title: Theories and Concepts of Health Behaviours
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: PHPC1022 or PHPC2008. Not for students who have taken CHPR3002, 3008, 4008 or PHPC1016

courses.title: Public Health Ethics and Law
courses.prereq: Pre-requisite: PHPC1001 or UGEC1920 or MEDF1021 or UGEC2930.

courses.title: Evidence Based Public Health and Healthcare
courses.prereq: For students of new curriculum only. Not for students who have taken PHPC2014. Pre-requisites: PHPC2015 & PHPC2017.

courses.title: Economics and Financing in Healthcare Systems
Practical Data Collection, Management and Analysis
courses.prereq: Not for students who have taken SOCI3229 Pre-requisites: (CHPR3117 or PHPC1014 or PHPC2017) and (CHPR3115 or PHPC1015 or PHPC2015)

courses.title: Health and Healthcare Organisation and Management

explanatory_notes:
Explanatory Note:

1.

This Minor Programme is not applicable to students who major in Community Health Practice, Gerontology, and Biotechnology, Entrepreneurship and Healthcare Management.

2.

No more than 9 units of courses taken to fulfill the requirements of the students’ Major Programme(s) and other Minor Programme(s) respectively can be used to fulfill the requirement of this Minor Programme.
